So presumably the extcap is to handle a live capture that some program is doing, continually writing new records to a file, with the extcap reading the file as it's being written to, picking up new packets as they arrive?

(If it's to read a completely-written file, that's not what extcaps are for, that's what files in libwiretap are for; that also lets you avoid using `DLT_USER` values and requiring the user to configure `DLT_USER0` to call the EMS dissector.)

Indeed, the main purpose will be to read completely-written files. Thanks for the hint to libwiretap files. I will take a look and revise the merge request. Setting the request to draft for the moment.
Merge request was revised and now provides a wiretap implementation.
